As a practical matter, the Senate no longer exists.''"<br />"''The constitution is in shreds...amendment after amendment...|Padmé Amidala, Mon Mothma and Giddean Danu, discussing Palpatine's rise to power|audio=SeedsOfRebellion.flac|<ref name="Episode III">{{Film|III}}</ref>}}
'''Giddean Danu''' was the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] from [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He was appointed to his position by [[Onara Kuat]], head of the [[House Kuat|Kuat family]] and principal director of [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Senator, I fear you underestimate the amount of corruption that has taken hold in the Senate.|Giddean Danu to Padmé Amidala|audio=DanuOnCorruption.flac|<ref name="Episode III" />}}
Grim and humorless, Danu was among the Senators that opposed [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] growing emergency powers. This brought him into conflict with many people on Kuat, who benefited from increased production in Kuat's [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|shipyards]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. His opposition to increased militarization led him to be twice nearly recalled from office by [[Onara Kuat]] and the Kuati electorate.

Danu was one of the Senators that met Palpatine at the [[Republic Executive Building/Legends|Republic Executive Building]] after the Chancellor was [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|rescued]] from [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]' [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]].<ref name="Episode III" />

The Senator had good ties with the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and greatly respected their Order, believing the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|nascent rebellion]] being led by [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] and [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]] needed the support of the Jedi in order to succeed, he supported Amidala on her claim that without the Jedi they would fail. Danu, following Mothma and Organa's lead, became part of the [[Delegation of 2000]], although he did not accompany the group when their [[Petition of 2000|petition]] was rejected by Palpatine.

==Personality and traits==
Standing 1.96 [[Meter/Legends|meters]],<ref name="db" /> Danu was taller than the average Human.<ref name="RPGRCR">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Revised Core Rulebook]]''</ref> He often wore a white ceremonial dress that resembled the garb of the [[Kuati Security Forces]].<ref name="Card-FFGTCG-Kuati Security Team">{{FFGTCG|set=Star Wars: The Card Game Core Set|cardname=Kuati Security Team}}</ref>, he was the only senator who supported Amidala to talk with the Jedi for the petition of the 2000.

==Behind the scenes==
Giddean Danu was played by [[Christopher Kirby]] in scenes deleted from the final release of [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Revenge of the Sith'']].

''[[What's The Story?]]'' author [[Aidan Hennessy]] intended to state him being [[Mayor/Legends|mayor]] of [[Kuat City]] prior to becoming senator (a reference to [[Wikipedia:Mahmoud Ahmadinejad|Mahmoud Ahmadinejad]]). He also ended his entry with a sentence saying that Danu was killed by [[Ottegru Grey]], but it was removed from the final entry.
